prospective_PR_grammar.grade: Both HARC_RC and CLASSICAL_CTLS receive exactly the same case input and can return an identical repair-frontier result or same abstention. Unverified rights/effect => both UNKNOWN
prospective_PR_grammar.experimental_status: Source-conditioned, not genuinely future-created PR forecast: cohort existed before freeze but content unread. No prospective deployed work or human effort inference.

novelty_threshold: No claim of original universal SOLID theory. Need source-certified adequate abstraction plus prereg source-repair forecasts that beat equal-information classical model on new independent domains; otherwise classical adequacy accepted.
